def regions(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):

                while stack:
                    r,c=stack.pop()

                    seen.add((r,c)); comp.add((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
